name: @openwork/computer
description: A Firefox that stays signed in, in a small Linux VM on your Mac, that you and your agents can drive.

scripts.start: bun run build && bun src/cli.ts serve
scripts.dev: bun --watch src/server.ts & cd web && bun run dev
scripts.build: cd web && bun install && bun run build
scripts.release: bun run build && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/cli.ts --outfile dist/computer/computer && mkdir -p dist/computer/web && cp -R web/dist dist/computer/web/ && cp -R image dist/computer/ && tar -C dist -czf dist/computer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz computer
